technical.summary: Strong structural bullish alignment across moving averages and Ichimoku, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9: 91.6, Stoch: 93.89) with stochastic bearish cross and weak ADX trend confirmation create elevated pullback risk for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 44 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (35 score) presents contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional data (264+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (455.84), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring energy multinationals, with earnings event in 44 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Ichimoku bullish cross and Supertrend confirmation provides structural upside alignment in a fear-driven market contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (91.6) with stochastic bearish cross, weak ADX trend confirmation (22.81), zero fundamental support, high earnings risk in 44 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish (price above MAs, Ichimoku cross, Supertrend), but extreme RSI overbought (91.6) with stochastic bearish cross and weak ADX trend confirmation signal imminent pullback risk unsuitable for swing entry at current price.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (455.84) combined with earnings in 44 days and rising dollar headwinds create macro execution risk that outweighs technical setup strength; overbought momentum likely to reverse before swing target.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if forced to enter, use ATR trail 1x with hard stop at recent swing low.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought, fundamental weakness, and macro crisis create consensus rejection.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 23 Energy positions with existing KMI exposure; sector concentration and portfolio saturation reduce conviction further; skip to preserve capital in high-volatility environment.
